regime_context: China A-shares detector shows narrow eligibility (5 of 22 themes) and a contested tech-led leadership: Semiconductors (rank 1, eligible, trend, moderate durability 0.58, not crowded) leads narrowly over AI Compute & Optics. The absolute-trend gate historically failed to cut drawdown here (mean-reverting tape), and the detector has a 2/7 local track record – low signal confidence. Innovative Pharma (rank 3) is crowded, a sizing flag, not a fade.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics – close challenger (margin 0.142); watch for durability crossover above Semiconductors or breadth expansion. Kill-criterion: Semiconductors’ durability stays >0.5 and breadth >0.3 over the next 10 days, or the margin widens >0.3, confirming the challenge fades.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors holds the top momentum rank and passes the (experimental) trend gate with hurst_tag=trend. Durability (0.58) and breadth (0.364) are moderate but better than most peers, and the theme is not crowded. Conditional overweight only as long as trend health persists; failure on breadth or durability suggests the leadership is hollow.
evidence: rank #1 with score 2.025, eligible (trend gate OK)
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate historically provided no drawdown edge in China A-shares (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is near zero. This leadership may be noise rather than sustainable trend.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors' durability falls below 0.4 OR breadth drops below 0.2, indicating trend health is deteriorating; the call is invalidated.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
